name: SpecsMap Plugin UI
description: DOM structure, interactions, visual states, and rendering details for the SpecsMap dependency graph viewer. The UI consists of a header bar, a pannable/zoomable viewport containing an SVG edge layer and an HTML node layer, and a slide-in detail panel on the right.

dom.container: Appended to the .card-body of a PluginCard with padding:0

elements.header: #sm-plugin-header > div (first child of .el) — padding:6px 14px 6px 16px, font-size:13px, font-weight:700, letter-spacing:1.5px, color:var(--accent), border-bottom:1px solid var(--border), user-select:none, flex-shrink:0, z-index:10, display:flex, align-items:center, gap:12px. Inner HTML: 'SPECS MAP' + subtitle '.sm-header-sub (font-size:11px, color:var(--tertiary))', then validation badge, then .sm-header-btn (refresh icon), then .sm-header-btn (reset-view eye icon).
elements.content: #sm-plugin-content (second child of .el) — flex:1, position:relative, overflow:hidden. Contains the viewport and panel.
elements.svg_layer: SVG element (position:absolute, inset:0, width:100%, height:100%, pointer-events:none, z-index:1, overflow:visible). Contains <defs> with arrow markers (one per layer color + hover variant) and two <g> groups: one for UI parent-child dashed edges, one for dependency edges (glow path + solid line with marker).
elements.node_layer: Div (position:absolute, inset:0, z-index:2). Transformed via CSS transform: translate(panX, panY) scale(scale) with transform-origin:0 0. Contains .sm-node divs for each spec node and .sm-layer-header divs for each layer label.
elements.sm_node: .sm-node (position:absolute, border:1px dashed var(--border), border-radius:8px, background:var(--surface), cursor:pointer, transition:box-shadow 0.15s, border-color 0.15s, opacity 0.15s, border-style 0.1s, box-shadow:var(--shadow), overflow:hidden, box-sizing:border-box). Main nodes: 280x100. UI sub-nodes: 230x62 + class .sm-node-ui.
elements.sm_node_inner: .sm-node-inner — padding:12px 16px, display:flex, flex-direction:column, gap:5px, height:100%, box-sizing:border-box. Contains .sm-node-head (flex row with .sm-dot + .sm-name + .sm-layer-badge), .sm-file, .sm-meta.
elements.sm_dot: .sm-dot — 10px width/height, border-radius:50%, flex-shrink:0. Color matches LAYER_COLORS_HEX for the node's layer. UI sub-nodes: 8px width/height, opacity:0.6.
elements.sm_name: .sm-name — font-size:14px, font-weight:700, color:var(--primary), line-height:1.3, flex:1, overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, white-space:nowrap. UI sub-nodes: font-size:13px, opacity:0.7.
elements.sm_file: .sm-file — font-size:12px, color:var(--tertiary), overflow:hidden, text-overflow:ellipsis, white-space:nowrap. UI sub-nodes: font-size:11px.
elements.sm_meta: .sm-meta — font-size:11px, color:var(--secondary), margin-top:auto, display:flex, gap:8px. Shows dep count (→N), ref count (←N), or 'no links' for isolated nodes.
elements.sm_layer_header: .sm-layer-header — position:absolute, font-size:15px, font-weight:700, letter-spacing:1.5px, user-select:none, pointer-events:none, opacity:0.55. Placed 100px left of first node in layer, width:94px, text-align:right.
elements.sm_header_btn: .sm-header-btn — border:none, outline:none, background:none, border-radius:6px, padding:5px 7px, color:var(--tertiary), cursor:pointer, line-height:0. Hover: color:var(--accent), background:var(--surface). Focus-visible: outline:none. Contains SVG icon (16x16, stroke currentColor).
elements.panel: Div (position:absolute, right:0, top:0, bottom:0, width:320px, background:var(--surface), border-left:1px dashed var(--border), z-index:20, transform:translateX(100%) by default, transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), display:flex, flex-direction:column, overflow:hidden). Contains .sm-panel-inner (flex:1, overflow-y:auto) that holds sections.
elements.panel_section: .sm-panel-section — padding:14px 18px, border-bottom:1px solid var(--border). Sections: Header (color dot 12px + name 14px bold + layer badge 10px + close × 18px), Identity (spec file, source file, parent/child links), Description (12px, line-height:1.6), Depends On (clickable nav items 12px), Referenced By (clickable nav items), IPC Channels (12px). Panel labels font-size:11px, letter-spacing:1px, margin-bottom:10px.

interactions.name: wheel_zoom
interactions.trigger: wheel event on .viewport with ctrlKey true
interactions.action: e.preventDefault(). Compute mx, my relative to viewport. oldScale = scale. maxScale = max(fitScale * 2, 1.0). scale = clamp(fitScale * 0.8, maxScale, scale * (1 + -deltaY * 0.001)). panX = mx - (mx - panX) * (scale / oldScale). panY = my - (my - panY) * (scale / oldScale). applyTransform().
interactions.result: Viewport content scales centered on cursor position

interactions.name: canvas_pan_start
interactions.action: isPanning = true. Record panStartX/Y = clientX/Y, panStartPanX/Y = current panX/panY. Set cursor:grabbing.
interactions.cursor: grabbing on viewport, revert on mouseup

interactions.name: canvas_pan_move
interactions.trigger: mousemove on document while isPanning true
interactions.action: panX = panStartPanX + (clientX - panStartX). panY = panStartPanY + (clientY - panStartY). applyTransform().

interactions.name: node_click
interactions.action: e.stopPropagation(). Get node id from dataset.id. If same node already selected and panel is open, close panel. Otherwise: deselect previous (remove .sm-selected class), set selectedId, add .sm-selected class to new node, call openPanel(node).
interactions.result: Side panel slides in showing spec details for the clicked node. If already selected, panel slides out.

interactions.name: canvas_background_click
interactions.action: If e.target is not inside .sm-node, call closePanel().
interactions.result: Side panel slides out (translateX: 100%), selectedId cleared, .sm-selected class removed

interactions.name: node_hover_enter
interactions.action: Compute connected set (node + deps + parentId + uiChildId + reverse deps + reverse parent/child). For all SVG paths: if connected, accent style with animated dash-flow; if not, opacity 0.04. For all node elements: if connected, border-color = layer hex, border-style solid, box-shadow glow, opacity 1; if not, opacity 0.14.
interactions.result: Connected nodes and edges highlighted, rest dimmed

interactions.name: node_hover_leave
interactions.action: For all SVG paths: remove dasharray, restore layer color, restore stroke-width, restore marker-end, restore opacity per etype (dep:0.3, glow:0.06, ui:0.25). For all node elements: reset opacity, reset border color/style to match selected state (if selected) or default.
interactions.result: All nodes and edges restore to default or selected-state appearance

interactions.name: panel_nav_click
interactions.action: Get target node id from dataset.goto. Call selectNode(targetId).
interactions.result: Panel updates to show the referenced node's details

interactions.name: panel_close_click
interactions.result: Panel slides closed and selection cleared

states.default: All nodes at full opacity with dashed borders. All edges at base opacity (dep 0.3, glow 0.06, ui 0.25). No box-shadow on nodes. No edge animation.
states.hover: Connected nodes: solid border colored by layer hex, box-shadow glow (0 0 0 1px <hex>33, 0 0 14px <hex>22), opacity 1. Non-connected nodes: opacity 0.14, no border/glow overrides. Connected dependency edges: stroke var(--accent), stroke-width 2, marker-end #sm-mk-hover, stroke-dasharray 6 3, animated dash-offset flow via .sm-edge-active (animation: sm-flow 0.8s linear infinite). Non-connected edges: opacity 0.04 (glow 0.01).
states.selected: Selected node has .sm-selected class (border-style: solid, no dash). Panel visible at translateX(0). Other nodes at default opacity. Edges at default opacity.
states.panel_open: .panel has transform:translateX(0), transition:transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1). PanelInner has overflow-y:auto for scrolling content sections.
states.panel_closed: .panel has transform:translateX(100%), occluded off the right edge.
states.loading: Constructor called but loadSpecs() has not completed. No nodes rendered yet. Header visible.
states.error:
If loadSpecs() throws, .nodeLayer contains: '
Error loading specs
'
states.empty: No spec files found in src/specs/ directory. fitGraph() returns early with no nodes. No layer headers rendered.

rendering.node_dimensions: Main spec nodes: 280x100 (NODE_W x NODE_H). UI sub-spec nodes: 230x62 (NODE_UI_W x NODE_UI_H). Gap between nodes: 28px (NODE_GAP). Gap between layers: 60px (LAYER_GAP). UI offset below parent: 64px (UI_OFFSET_Y).
rendering.layout_formula: For each layer in LAYER_ORDER: compute rowW = items.length * NODE_W + (items.length-1) * NODE_GAP. startX = -rowW / 2. Position each item at (startX + i*(NODE_W+NODE_GAP), globalY). UI sub-nodes centered below parent: x = parent.x + (NODE_W-NODE_UI_W)/2, y = globalY + NODE_H + UI_OFFSET_Y. Advance globalY by NODE_H + (hasUI ? UI_OFFSET_Y+NODE_UI_H+20 : 0) + LAYER_GAP.
rendering.edge_rendering: Cubic bezier curves via SVG <path d='Mx1,y1 Ccx1,cy1 cx2,cy2 x2,y2'>. For same-row edges: horizontal curve with control points at 45% of horizontal distance on each side. For vertical edges: control points at 10% horizontal offset and 50% vertical distance. For UI parent-child edges: vertical curve with control points at 50% vertical distance. Each dependency edge has two paths: a glow path (stroke-width 6, opacity 0.06) behind a solid line (stroke-width 1.5, opacity 0.3) with an arrow marker at the target.
rendering.layer_colors: foundation: #4ade80 (var(--green)), core: #5a8af4 (var(--accent)), widget: #a78bfa (var(--accent2)), modal: #fbbf24 (var(--amber)), overlay: #f87171 (var(--red)), plugins: #94a3b8 (var(--secondary)).
rendering.fit_graph_formula: On initial load: compute graph bounding box from all nodes. fitX = (viewportWidth - 160) / graphWidth, fitY = (viewportHeight - 160) / graphHeight. fitScale = min(fitX, fitY, 1.0). scale = fitScale. panX = (viewportWidth - graphWidth*scale)/2 - minX*scale. panY = (viewportHeight - graphHeight*scale)/2 - minY*scale.
